correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the Neron--Severi calculation from the source's \(t=4\) formulas. For any irreducible root \(\Gamma=aL-\sum b_iA_i\) distinct from the \(A_i\), the equality \(\sum b_i^2=8a^2+1\) and Cauchy--Schwarz exclude \(F\cdot\Gamma<0\). Equality \(F\cdot\Gamma=0\) forces \(a=0\); Lemma 8 then forces integral \(b_i\) and hence one original \(A_j\). Thus the contracted roots are exactly \(A_5,\ldots,A_{16}\). Saint-Donat's base-point obstruction would require \(E=(F-A_j)/2\), whose \(L\)-coefficient \(1/4\) contradicts Lemma 8. The resulting degree-two model has \(F=A_i+B_i\), forcing its involution to exchange \(A_i\) and \(B_i\). Exact lattice identities were replayed by `verify.py`.
